import json
import urllib.request

def test_pyproject_schema_is_draft7(tmp_path):
    out = tmp_path / "schema.json"
    with urllib.request.urlopen("https://json.schemastore.org/pyproject.json", timeout=5) as resp:
        out.write_bytes(resp.read())
    data = json.loads(out.read_text())
    assert data["$schema"] == "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"

import pathlib
import subprocess
import tempfile

def test_archive_roundtrip_lists_single_member():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="arch-") as d:
        root = pathlib.Path(d)
        (root / "in.txt").write_text("payload\n")
        subprocess.run(["tar", "-cf", str(root / "a.tar"), "-C", str(root), "in.txt"], check=True)
        listing = subprocess.run(["tar", "-tf", str(root / "a.tar")], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
        assert listing.stdout.splitlines() == ["in.txt"]

import subprocess
import sys

def test_verifier_rejects_malformed_report(tmp_path):
    bad = tmp_path / "report.json"
    bad.write_text("{not json")
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "tools/verify_report.py", str(bad)], capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
    assert proc.returncode == 2
    assert proc.stdout == ""
    assert proc.stderr.strip() == f"error: malformed report: {bad}"

import pytest

def test_parse_duration_rejects_unknown_unit():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=r"^unknown unit 'w' in '3w'$"):
        parse_duration("3w")
    assert parse_duration("90s") == 90

import subprocess
import sys

def test_epoch_renders_in_utc(tmp_path):
    env = {"PATH": "/usr/bin:/bin", "HOME": str(tmp_path), "TZ": "UTC", "LC_ALL": "C"}
    code = "import time; print(time.strftime('%H:%M', time.localtime(0)))"
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    assert proc.stdout == "00:00\n"

import subprocess

def test_tag_points_at_head(tmp_path):
    def git(*args):
        cmd = ["git", "-C", str(tmp_path), "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false", "-c", "tag.gpgsign=false", "-c", "core.hooksPath=", *args]
        return subprocess.run(cmd, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    git("init", "-q")
    (tmp_path / "a.txt").write_text("a\n")
    git("add", "a.txt")
    git("commit", "-q", "-m", "a")
    git("tag", "v0.1.0")
    assert git("rev-parse", "v0.1.0^{commit}").stdout == git("rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout

#!/usr/bin/env bash

export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1
git init -q "$root/repo"
g() { git -C "$root/repo" -c user.name=Fixture -c user.email=fx@example.invalid -c commit.gpgsign=false -c core.hooksPath="$root/hooks" "$@"; }
printf 'x\n' > "$root/repo/f"
g add f
g commit -q -m seed
[ -z "$(ls -A "$root/hooks")" ] && [ "$(g log --format=%an:%s)" = "Fixture:seed" ]
